description: OIDC Role Trust Has Missing or Wildcard Audience Constraint (Review)
rationale: An OIDC role trust statement lacks an explicit aud claim condition or uses wildcard matching. AWS validates IdP client IDs separately, so this is a defense-in-depth review rather than proof of accepted tokens from other audiences.
remediation: Set provider-correct exact audience restrictions and audit identity provider client IDs and accepted token claims.
